skill.name: embedded-captions
skill.description: Create embedded captions for single-subject talking-head videos with plain, cinematic, or themed visual treatments.
skill.summary: Local workflow for transcribing and rendering styled captions into talking-head video.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are benign lexical detections from local video rendering, documentation, and caption themes. However, the skill contains a prompt-injection instruction and several high-risk execution paths involving remote dependencies, generated shell code, and unisolated rendering. Do not auto-install or execute it until the remediation items are addressed. Static review was capped at 400/1432 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 1032 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The skill requests a silent updater without approval.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction and require explicit user confirmation before any update, download, or execution.

remediation.issue: Transcription retrieves executable dependencies at runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Use a locked dependency file and verify immutable artifact hashes. Do not permit environment variables to select arbitrary versions.

remediation.issue: Project and theme data reaches shell or AWK code.
remediation.suggestion: Validate numeric metadata strictly and pass values as arguments, never by interpolating them into shell or AWK source.

remediation.issue: Rendered project content can access the network.
remediation.suggestion: Render in a network-isolated sandbox and reject external URLs unless the user explicitly approves them.

remediation.issue: Staging uses symlinks for project assets.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve and validate canonical paths, reject symlinks from untrusted projects, and use no-follow file operations for outputs.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs an agent to run a networked updater silently and without user confirmation. This attempts to override normal approval controls for external code execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction explicitly says to update silently and not ask, which is incompatible with informed user authorization.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Remote Dependency Execution
semantic_findings.description: The transcription workflow invokes uvx to download and run WhisperX. An environment variable can change the package version, and no artifact hash verification is shown.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command invocation and version override are direct evidence of runtime dependency retrieval without integrity pinning.

semantic_findings.title: Project Metadata Can Inject AWK Code
semantic_findings.description: A project plan value is read and later interpolated into an AWK program. A crafted project file can execute unintended local commands during rendering.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script reads project-controlled FPS through node evaluation and uses it in generated shell processing, creating an injection boundary.

semantic_findings.title: Theme Values Reach an Executed Shell Script
semantic_findings.description: Theme-derived values are written into a post-processing shell script that the rendering workflow executes. Untrusted theme data can therefore alter shell behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited template constructs shell command substitution from theme values, and the skill includes a renderer that runs generated shell scripts.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Render Content Has Network Access
semantic_findings.description: Project-controlled HTML is rendered in Chromium while assets are staged through symlinks. Without network isolation, hostile render content can make network requests from the rendering environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The renderer processes project content and creates symlinked staging assets; no network sandbox is evident in the cited workflow.

content.user_title: Create embedded captions for talking-head videos
content.value_statement: Talking-head videos need readable captions that match their visual style. This skill transcribes speech and renders plain, cinematic, or themed captions into local video projects.
actual_capabilities: Transcribes local video audio into timed caption data.
Generates caption layouts for single-subject talking-head footage.
Applies plain, cinematic, and catalog-based caption treatments.
Measures caption layout and checks safe zones.
Renders local video layers and composites caption outputs.
limitations: Multi-shot footage must be split before processing.
Some workflows download models or dependencies at runtime.
Rendering requires local media tools and compatible browser dependencies.

use_cases.title: Publish accessible social videos
use_cases.description: Add timed, readable captions to a short talking-head video.

use_cases.title: Create branded video explainers
use_cases.description: Apply a selected visual caption identity to an internal product video.

use_cases.title: Prepare reviewable caption renders
use_cases.description: Generate caption layers and layout checks for a production review.

prompt_templates.title: Add basic captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create plain embedded captions for this single-subject talking-head video.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a visual style
prompt_templates.prompt: Add cinematic captions with the anchor rail style. Keep the footage unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Check caption placement
prompt_templates.prompt: Create themed captions, then check safe zones and overflow before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a review render
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe this single-subject video, apply the selected theme, and create caption layers for review.

output_examples.input: Add plain captions to a 30-second interview clip.
Use a cinematic caption identity for a product announcement.
Check a caption render before publishing.

best_practices: Use clean, single-subject footage with clear speech.
Review generated transcripts before final rendering.
Check safe zones and overflow on the target aspect ratio.
anti_patterns: Do not use unsplit multi-shot footage.
Do not assume automatic transcription is error-free.
Do not run runtime downloads without reviewing their source and version.

faq.question: What videos work best?
faq.answer: Single-subject talking-head videos with clear speech work best.

faq.question: Can it edit the original footage?
faq.answer: No. The skill adds caption layers without changing the source footage.

faq.question: Can it create cinematic captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports cinematic and catalog-based visual caption treatments.

faq.question: Does it support multi-shot videos?
faq.answer: Split multi-shot footage before using this workflow.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Some transcription and matting workflows may download dependencies or model weights.

faq.question: Should I review the output?
faq.answer: Yes. Review transcript accuracy, placement, and final rendering before publishing.
